content.definition: Exchange of nonmonetary assets (PPE, inventory, intangibles) between parties with little or no cash (boot) involved
content.general_principle: Exchanges measured at FAIR VALUE of assets given up (or received if more reliable), with gain or loss recognized

commercial_substance.definition: Exchange has commercial substance if future cash flows expected to change significantly as a result of exchange
indicators: Configuration (risk, timing, amount) of cash flows of asset received differs significantly from asset given up
Entity-specific value of operations affected by exchange changes significantly
Difference in above is significant relative to fair values of assets exchanged
commercial_substance.if_has_commercial_substance: Record at FAIR VALUE, recognize FULL gain or loss
commercial_substance.if_lacks_commercial_substance: May use carrying value, defer gains (losses recognized)

has_commercial_substance.measurement: Fair value of asset given up (or asset received if more reliable)
has_commercial_substance.formula: Asset Received = FV of asset given up. Gain/Loss = FV of asset given - BV of asset given
has_commercial_substance.entry: DR Asset Received (FV), DR Accumulated Depreciation (old asset), CR Asset Given (cost), CR/DR Gain or Loss (plug)

lacks_commercial_substance_no_boot.measurement: Book value of asset given up
lacks_commercial_substance_no_boot.entry: DR Asset Received (BV of old asset), DR Accumulated Depreciation, CR Asset Given (cost). No gain/loss.

lacks_commercial_substance_with_boot.boot_payer: Records at BV of asset given + cash paid. No gain/loss.
lacks_commercial_substance_with_boot.boot_receiver: Recognize GAIN proportionately (based on boot received). Loss recognized in full if present.
lacks_commercial_substance_with_boot.partial_gain_formula: Gain recognized = Total gain × (Boot received / (Boot + FV of asset received))

boot_transactions.definition: Cash (or other monetary consideration) included in exchange to equalize fair values

boot_payer.payment: Pays cash in addition to giving asset
boot_payer.measurement: Asset received = FV of asset given + cash paid
boot_payer.gain_loss: If commercial substance: Full gain/loss. If no commercial substance: No gain/loss recognized.

boot_receiver.receipt: Receives cash in addition to asset
boot_receiver.measurement: Asset received = FV of asset given - cash received
boot_receiver.gain_loss: If commercial substance: Full gain/loss. If no commercial substance and boot >25% of fair value: recognize FULL gain. If boot <25%: recognize PARTIAL gain. Loss always recognized in full.

boot_transactions.25_percent_rule: If boot received ≥25% of total consideration (boot + FV of asset received), treat as monetary transaction (recognize full gain)

example_1_commercial_substance_no_boot.facts: Exchange truck (cost $50K, Acc Depr $30K, BV $20K, FV $25K) for equipment (FV $25K). Has commercial substance.
example_1_commercial_substance_no_boot.entry: DR Equipment $25,000, DR Accumulated Depreciation $30,000, CR Truck $50,000, CR Gain $5,000

example_2_no_commercial_substance_no_boo.facts: Same facts as Example 1, but NO commercial substance.
example_2_no_commercial_substance_no_boo.calculation: No gain recognized. Record equipment at BV of truck.
example_2_no_commercial_substance_no_boo.entry: DR Equipment $20,000, DR Accumulated Depreciation $30,000, CR Truck $50,000. No gain.

example_3_commercial_substance_pay_boot.facts: Exchange truck (cost $50K, Acc Depr $30K, BV $20K, FV $25K) + cash $10K for equipment (FV $35K). Has commercial substance.
example_3_commercial_substance_pay_boot.entry: DR Equipment $35,000, DR Acc Depr $30,000, CR Truck $50,000, CR Cash $10,000, CR Gain $5,000

example_4_no_commercial_substance_receiv.facts: Exchange truck (cost $50K, Acc Depr $30K, BV $20K, FV $30K) for equipment (FV $25K) + cash $5K. NO commercial substance.
calculation: Boot received / Total consideration received = $5K / ($25K + $5K) = 16.7% (less than 25%)
Asset received basis = BV given - cash received - gain recognized = $20K - $5K - $1,667 = $13,333
example_4_no_commercial_substance_receiv.entry: DR Equipment $13,333, DR Cash $5,000, DR Acc Depr $30,000, CR Truck $50,000, CR Gain $1,667

example_5_loss_always_recognized.facts: Exchange equipment (cost $100K, Acc Depr $60K, BV $40K, FV $30K) for truck (FV $30K). NO commercial substance.
example_5_loss_always_recognized.calculation: Loss = FV $30K - BV $40K = $10K loss. Losses ALWAYS recognized in full.
example_5_loss_always_recognized.entry: DR Truck $30,000, DR Loss $10,000, DR Acc Depr $60,000, CR Equipment $100,000

special_cases.exchange_of_inventory: If inventory exchanged for dissimilar inventory (or PPE): Use FV, recognize gain/loss. If similar inventory to facilitate sales to customers: NO gain/loss, use BV.
special_cases.exchange_of_similar_productive_assets: If lacks commercial substance: Defer gain. Purpose is to avoid manipulation by swapping similar assets to create artificial gains.

cpa_exam_tips: Commercial substance = recognize FULL gain or loss at FV
No commercial substance = defer gains (use BV), but ALWAYS recognize losses
Boot payer (pays cash): Asset received = FV of asset given + cash paid (if commercial substance)
Boot receiver (receives cash): May recognize partial gain if no commercial substance and boot <25%
Formula for partial gain: Total gain × (Boot / Total consideration received)
Losses ALWAYS recognized in full (even if no commercial substance)

decision_framework: 1. Determine if exchange has commercial substance
2. Identify if boot involved (and if payer or receiver)
3. Determine gain or loss (FV - BV of asset given)
4. Apply recognition rules based on commercial substance and boot

no_commercial_substance.boot_receiver: Partial gain if boot <25%. Full gain if boot ≥25%. Full loss always.

common_mistakes: Recognizing gain when no commercial substance and no boot (should defer)
Forgetting to recognize loss in full even when no commercial substance
Incorrectly calculating partial gain for boot receiver (use boot / total consideration received)
Using FV when should use BV (no commercial substance scenarios)

key_points: Commercial substance: Recognize full gain/loss at FV
No commercial substance: Defer gains (use BV), recognize losses in full
Boot payer: Asset received = FV given + cash paid (if commercial substance) or BV given + cash paid (if no commercial substance)
Boot receiver: May recognize partial gain if no commercial substance and boot <25%
Partial gain formula: Total gain × (Boot / Total consideration received)
Losses always recognized regardless of commercial substance
